contentItem.title: 性质与证明：圆柱与圆锥与直径
contentItem.englishTitle: Similar cones and cylinders are to one another in the triplicate ratio of the diameters in their bases.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Similar cones and cylinders are to one another in the triplicate ratio of the diameters in their bases.
类似的锥形和圆柱形在底边直径的立方比之间。

Let there be similar cones and cylinders, let the circles ABCD, EFGH be their bases, BD, FH the diameters of the bases, and KL, MN the axes of the cones and cylinders; I say that the cone of which the circle ABCD is the base and the point L the vertex has to the cone of which the circle EFGH is the base and the point N the vertex the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH.
类似锥体和圆锥体的圆锥体为ABCD,EFGH,底边,BD,底边直径为FH,锥体和圆锥体的轴线为KL,MN;我说圆锥体的圆锥体为ABCD,顶点为L,圆锥体的圆锥体为底边,EFGH是底边,而顶点为N,垂直点为BD至FH的垂直比。

For, if the cone ABCDL has not to the cone EFGHN the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH, the cone ABCDL will have that triplicate ratio either to some solid less than the cone EFGHN or to a greater.
因为,如果ABCDL锥体与EFGHN锥体的比重没有增加,BD锥体与FH的比重为三倍,则ABCDL锥体的比重为立方比比低于EFGHN锥体的固体或大于ABCDL。
First, let it have that triplicate ratio to a less solid O.
首先,让它有立方比到不那么坚实的O。
Let the square EFGH be inscribed in the circle EFGH; [[IV. 6](/principles/euclid-4-6)] therefore the square EFGH is greater than the half of the circle EFGH.
让正方形 EFGH在EFGH圆内登记,因此正方形 EFGH圆大于EFGH圆的一半。 [[IV. 6](/principles/euclid-4-6)]
Now let there be set up on the square EFGH a pyramid having the same vertex with the cone; therefore the pyramid so set up is greater than the half part of the cone.
现在让我们在正方形 EFGH金字塔上 设置一个金字塔, 与锥体有着相同的顶点。 因此,如此建立的金字塔 大于锥体的一半。
Let the circumferences EF, FG, GH, HE be bisected at the points P, Q, R, S, and let EP, PF, FQ, QG, GR, RH, HS, SE be joined.
让EF、FG、GH、HE环绕线在P、Q、R、S点两分为两部分,让EP、PF、FQ、QG、GR、RH、HS、SE环绕线连接。
Therefore each of the triangles EPF, FQG, GRH, HSE is also greater than the half part of that segment of the circle EFGH which is about it.
因此,EPF、FQG、GRH、HSE三角形的每一个三角形也都大于EFGH圆的这一段的一半。

Now on each of the triangles EPF, FQG, GRH, HSE let a pyramid be set up having the same vertex with the cone; therefore each of the pyramids so set up is also greater than the half part of that segment of the cone which is about it.
现在在每一个三角形上 EPF,FQG,GRH,HSE 设置一个金字塔 与锥体有相同的顶点。 因此,每一个如此建立的金字塔 也都大于锥体的半部分。

Thus, bisecting the circumferences so left, joining straight lines, setting up on each of the triangles pyramids having the same vertex with the cone, and doing this continually, we shall leave some segments of the cone which will be less than the excess by which the cone EFGHN exceeds the solid O. [[X. 1](/principles/euclid-10-1)]
因此,在左侧的两条环形上,连接直线,在三角形上建立与锥体具有相同顶点的金字塔,并且不断这样做,我们将留下锥体的某些部分,这些部分将少于锥体EFGHN超过固体O的溢值。 [[X. 1](/principles/euclid-10-1)]

Let such be left, and let them be the segments on EP, PF, FQ, QG, GR, RH, HS, SE; therefore the remainder, the pyramid of which the polygon EPFQGRHS is the base and the point N the vertex, is greater than the solid O.
任由这些部分留下,并任由它们成为EP、PF、FQ、QG、GR、RH、HS、SE段;因此,其余部分,即多边形 EPFQGRHS是底边,N点是顶部,大于O的固体。

Let there be also inscribed in the circle ABCD the polygon ATBUCVDW similar and similarly situated to the polygon EPFQGRHS, and let there be set up on the polygon ATBUCVDW a pyramid having the same vertex with the cone; of the triangles containing the pyramid of which the polygon ATBUCVDW is the base and the point L the vertex let LBT be one, and of the triangles containing the pyramid of which the polygon EPFQGRHS is the base and the point N the vertex let NFP be one; and let KT, MP be joined.
也允许在ABCD圆圈上标注类似和类似于多边形 ERPQGRHS的多边形 ABBUCVDW,并在多边形 ABBUCVDW上标定一个金字塔,与锥体具有相同的顶端;三角形,其中多边形 ABBUCVDW是底边,L点 顶端是LBT, 三角形是多边形 EPFQGRHS是底边, N点 顶端是NFP; KT, MP连接。
Now, since the cone ABCDL is similar to the cone EFGHN, therefore, as BD is to FH, so is the axis KL to the axis MN. [[XI. Def. 24](/principles/euclid-11-def-24)]
现在,由于锥体ABCDL与锥体EFGHN相似,因此,BD对FH的比等于轴KL对轴MN的比 [[XI. Def. 24](/principles/euclid-11-def-24)]
But, as BD is to FH, so is BK to FM; therefore also, as BK is to FM, so is KL to MN.
但是,BD对FH的比等于BK对FM的比;因此,BK对FM的比等于KL对MN的比；BD 与 FH 之比等于 BK 与 FM 之比；BK 与 FM 之比等于 KL 与 MN 之比。
And, alternately, as BK is to KL, so is FM to MN. [[V. 16](/principles/euclid-5-16)]
反过来,BK比KL的比例等于FM比MN；BK 与 KL 之比等于 FM 与 MN 之比。 [[V. 16](/principles/euclid-5-16)]
And the sides are proportional about equal angles, namely the angles BKL, FMN; therefore the triangle BKL is similar to the triangle FMN. [[VI. 6](/principles/euclid-6-6)]
边是成比例,角是BKL,角是FMN。 因此三角形BKL和三角形FMN相似。 [[VI. 6](/principles/euclid-6-6)]

Again, since, as BK is to KT, so is FM to MP, and they are about equal angles, namely the angles BKT, FMP, inasmuch as, whatever part the angle BKT is of the four right angles at the centre K, the same part also is the angle FMP of the four right angles at the centre M; since then the sides are proportional about equal angles, therefore the triangle BKT is similar to the triangle FMP. [[VI. 6](/principles/euclid-6-6)]
同样,BK比KT等于FM比MP,它们与角度差不多,即角度BKT,FMP,因为无论BKT角在中心为4,直角,K,同一部分也是中心为4,直角的M,FMP角;从那时起,两边为成比例, 角度相同,因此三角形BKT与三角形FMP相似；BK 与 KT 之比等于 FM 与 MP 之比。 [[VI. 6](/principles/euclid-6-6)]

Again, since it was proved that, as BK is to KL, so is FM to MN, while BK is equal to KT, and FM to PM, therefore, as TK is to KL, so is PM to MN; and the sides are proportional about equal angles, namely the angles TKL, PMN, for they are right; therefore the triangle LKT is similar to the triangle NMP. [[VI. 6](/principles/euclid-6-6)]
同样,由于BK比KL的比例与FM比MN,BK等于KT,FM比PM,TK比KL,PM比PM,两边是成比例,角度相等,即角度TKL,PMN,因为它们是正确的;因此三角形LKT与三角形NMP相似；BK 与 KL 之比等于 FM 与 MN 之比；TK 与 KL 之比等于 PM 与 MN 之比。 [[VI. 6](/principles/euclid-6-6)]

And since, owing to the similarity of the triangles LKB, NMF, as LB is to BK, so is NF to FM, and, owing to the similarity of the triangles BKT, FMP, as KB is to BT, so is MF to FP, therefore, ex aequali, as LB is to BT, so is NF to FP. [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]

由于三角形LKB、NMF的相似性,LB至BK的比等于NF至FM的比,由于三角形BKT、FMP的相似性,KB至BT的比等于MF至FP的比,因此,从平等角度看,LB至BT的比等于NF至FP的比；LB 与 BK 之比等于 NF 与 FM 之比；KB 与 BT 之比等于 MF 与 FP 之比；LB 与 BT 之比等于 NF 与 FP 之比。 [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]

Again since, owing to the similarity of the triangles LTK, NPM, as LT is to TK, so is NP to PM, and, owing to the similarity of the triangles TKB, PMF, as KT is to TB, so is MP to PF; therefore, ex aequali, as LT is to TB, so is NP to PF. [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]

同样,由于三角形LTK、NPM的相似性,LT至TK的比等于NP至PM的比,由于三角形TKB、PMF的相似性,KT至TB的比等于MP至PF的比;因此,从平等的角度讲,LT至TB的比等于NP至PF的比；LT 与 TK 之比等于 NP 与 PM 之比；KT 与 TB 之比等于 MP 与 PF 之比；LT 与 TB 之比等于 NP 与 PF 之比。 [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
But it was also proved that, as TB is to BL, so is PF to FN.
但也有证据表明,TB对BL的比等于PF对FN的比；TB 与 BL 之比等于 PF 与 FN 之比。
Therefore, ex aequali, as TL is to LB, so is PN to NF. [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
因此,从平等角度看,TL比LB等于PN比NF；TL 与 LB 之比等于 PN 与 NF 之比。 [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]

Therefore in the triangles LTB, NPF the sides are proportional; therefore the triangles LTB, NPF are equiangular; [[VI. 5](/principles/euclid-6-5)] hence they are also similar. [[VI. Def. I](/principles/euclid-6-def-1)]
因此,三角形LTB、NPF的两边是成比例;三角形LTB、NPF是等角;因此,它们也是相似的。 [[VI. 5](/principles/euclid-6-5)] [[VI. Def. I](/principles/euclid-6-def-1)]

Therefore the pyramid of which the triangle BKT is the base and the point L the vertex is also similar to the pyramid of which the triangle FMP is the base and the point N the vertex, for they are contained by similar planes equal in multitude. [[XI. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-11-def-9)]
因此,三角形BKT是底边,顶点L也与金字塔类似,三角形FMP是底边,顶点N,因为其形成数量与类似平面相同。 [[XI. Def. 9](/principles/euclid-11-def-9)]
But similar pyramids which have triangular bases are to one another in the triplicate ratio of their corresponding sides. [[XII. 8](/principles/euclid-12-8)]
但类似金字塔的三角底边 彼此在它们对应的立方比面。 [[XII. 8](/principles/euclid-12-8)]
Therefore the pyramid BKTL has to the pyramid FMPN the ratio triplicate of that which BK has to FM.
因此,金字塔BKTL与金字塔FMPN的比例是BK比FM之比的三倍。

Similarly, by joining straight lines from A, W, D, V, C, U to K, and from E, S, H, R, G, Q to M, and setting up on each of the triangles pyramids which have the same vertex with the cones, we can prove that each of the similarly arranged pyramids will also have to each similarly arranged pyramid the ratio triplicate of that which the corresponding side BK has to the corresponding side FM, that is, which BD has to FH.
同样,通过将A、W、D、V、C、U至K直线和E、S、H、R、G、Q至M直线连接起来,并在每个三角形金字塔上架设与锥形具有相同顶点的三角形,我们可以证明,每一个类似排列的金字塔也都具有相应的金字塔,即BK对对应面FM的三倍比重,即BD对FH。

And, as one of the antecedents is to one of the consequents, so are all the antecedents to all the consequents; [[V. 12](/principles/euclid-5-12)] therefore also, as the pyramid BKTL is to the pyramid FMPN, so is the whole pyramid of which the polygon ATBUCVDW is the base and the point L the vertex to the whole pyramid of which the polygon EPFQGRHS is the base and the point N the vertex; hence also the pyramid of which ATBUCVDW is the base and the point L the vertex has to the pyramid of which the polygon EPFQGRHS is the base and the point N the vertex the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH.
其前奏之一,其后果之一,其前奏也各异;因此,金字塔BKTL是金字塔FMPN,其整个金字塔多边形ABUCVDW是底边,其顶点是L,其顶点是多边形EPFQGRHS是底边,而顶点是N;也因此是金字塔,其中ABBUCVDW是底边,顶部的点L, 金字塔的点多边形 EPFQGRHS是底边, 顶部是N, 与BD的比为FH。 [[V. 12](/principles/euclid-5-12)]

But, by hypothesis, the cone of which the circle ABCD is the base and the point L the vertex has also to the solid O the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH; therefore, as the cone of which the circle ABCD is the base and the point L the vertex is to the solid O, so is the pyramid of which the polygon ATBUCVDW is the base and L the vertex to the pyramid of which the polygon EPFQGRHS is the base and the point N the vertex; therefore, alternately, as the cone of which the circle ABCD is the base and L the vertex is to the pyramid contained in it of which the polygon ATBUCVDW is the base and L the vertex, so is the solid O to the pyramid of which the polygon EPFQGRHS is the base and N the vertex. [[V. 16](/principles/euclid-5-16)]

但是,假设ABCD圆的圆锥是底边,顶部的点是L, 圆锥的圆锥与O的固体比值是BD至FH的三倍;因此,圆ABCD的锥体之比为底边,顶点与固体O之点之比等于金字塔之比,多边形 ABBUCVDW为底边,L是金字塔之比,多边形 ERPQGRHS为底边,N点为顶点;因此,反过来,作为ABCD圆为底边和L的锥体,顶点位于金字塔,其中多边形 ABBUCVDW为底边和L顶点,而金字塔的O固体也是,其中多边形 EPFQGRHS为底边和N顶点。 [[V. 16](/principles/euclid-5-16)]
But the said cone is greater than the pyramid in it; for it encloses it.
但那个锥壳比金字塔还要大,因为它是附着的。
Therefore the solid O is also greater than the pyramid of which the polygon EPFQGRHS is the base and N the vertex.
因此,O固体也大于金字塔,其中多边形枚EPFQGRHS是顶部底边和N。
But it is also less: which is impossible.
但情况也更少:这是不可能做到的。

Therefore the cone of which the circle ABCD is the base and L the vertex has not to any solid less than the cone of which the circle EFGH is the base and the point N the vertex the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH:
因此,ABCD圆的圆锥体是底边和L, 顶点的坚固度不小于EFGH圆的圆锥体,ABCD点的顶点是BD比的三倍,即FH比的垂直度:（相关点与线段：N）
Similarly we can prove that neither has the cone EFGHN to any solid less than the cone ABCDL the ratio triplicate of that which FH has to BD.
同样,我们可以证明,EFGHN锥体与ABCDL锥体之比,两者中均无比FH锥体与BD锥体之比。
I say next that neither has the cone ABCDL to any solid greater than the cone EFGHN the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH.
接下来我说,ABCDL锥体的比重均大于EFGHN锥体的比重,BD锥体的比重为FH。
For, if possible, let it have that ratio to a greater solid O.
如果可能的话,让它拥有一个更大的O固体比例。
Therefore, inversely, the solid O has to the cone ABCDL the ratio triplicate of that which FH has to BD.
因此,O固体与ABCDL对齐,即FH对BD对齐之比的三倍。
But, as the solid O is to the cone ABCDL, so is the cone EFGHN to some solid less than the cone ABCDL.
但是,O固体对锥体ABCDL的比等于EFGHN锥体对ABCDL锥体某种固体比ABCDL锥体少。
Therefore the cone EFGHN also has to some solid less than the cone ABCDL the ratio triplicate of that which FH has to BD: which was proved impossible.
因此,EFGHN锥体的比重也比ABCDL锥体的比重低一些,FH比BD,这已证明是不可能的。
Therefore the cone ABCDL has not to any solid greater than the cone EFGHN the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH.
因此,ABCDL锥体的坚固度不超过BD至FH的3倍比EFGHN锥体的重合率。
But it was proved that neither has it this ratio to a less solid than the cone EFGHN.
但事实证明,两者的比都没有比EFGHN锥形的更牢固。
Therefore the cone ABCDL has to the cone EFGHN the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH.
因此,ABCDL锥体与EFGHN锥体的比重是BD比FH。

But, as the cone is to the cone, so is the cylinder to the cylinder, for the cylinder which is on the same base as the cone and of equal height with it is triple of the cone; [[XII. 10](/principles/euclid-12-10)] therefore the cylinder also has to the cylinder the ratio triplicate of that which BD has to FH.
但是,锥体与锥体之比等于圆柱体与圆柱体之比,圆锥体与圆锥体同在底边,与圆锥体同高为三倍;因此,圆锥体与圆锥体之比也等于BD至FH的三倍。 [[XII. 10](/principles/euclid-12-10)]
Therefore etc. Q. E. D.
因此,等等,证毕。
